name: Rastrigin: local minima
lesson: Rastrigin has a grid of local minima: a run can settle in one of them and miss the global minimum at (0, 0).
lookFor: With this seed the best so far after 100 generations is −0.995 (f = 0.995) at (0.00, −0.99), the minimum next to the global one, and the run never gets within ε of the optimum; the 12 individuals are spread over 2 cells of the grid of minima. With seeds 1 to 100, 81 runs reach ε and 19 do not; seed 42 reaches it in generation 19. A run that does not reach the optimum is part of the lesson.
